About Connect Four

Connect Four has the shortest rulebook and one of the deepest decision trees. Counters fall to the lowest free cell of the chosen column, so every move has to build your own line while blocking theirs.

JoyFlock adds four computer difficulty levels and private friend rooms, with board and drop feedback tuned for both mouse and touch.

How to play

  1. Take turns choosing a column; the counter falls to its lowest empty cell.
  2. Four matching counters in a row, column or diagonal win immediately.
  3. A full board with no line is a draw.

Frequently asked questions

Is Connect Four solved?
In theory yes — with perfect play the first player wins. In practice one missed block flips the result, which is exactly what makes it fun.
How many difficulty levels are there?
Four levels, easy by default. Your choice is remembered per game.
Can I play a friend online?
Yes — create a room and send the invite link.
